original_investigation_goal: 请调查这个 Issue，读取冻结源码、现有测试、项目规范和环境声明，确认报告的问题是否仍然存在并能用离线测试复现。若已修复、属于既有约定、缺少证据或环境能力不支持，请明确报告，不制造补丁。若确有缺陷，请准备最小修复方案：先新增回归测试并记录真实失败，再修改实现、执行项目要求的相关测试与静态检查、独立 Review。保持现有公共行为与所有必要检查，不用 help/version/echo 代替验证。当前只调查并保存可审阅方案，等待人工对精确 PlanVersion 批准，不实施、不发布、不修改上游。
resume_strategy: Existing native budget recovery creates a new read-only planning request against the same task/source/model and retains all old use and records. It is not a replay of an ambiguous model POST or proof of natural-language routing success.
expected_planning_request_text:
读取仓库并准备方案
User retry message (untrusted data): 继续
actions: Verify unchanged task, source, exact model/profile, failed payload and current budget revision.
Only after explicit confirmation, append a task-only budget version changing calls 38 to 50; retain 4M input and 200K output, all known use and unknown reserves.

Send one native explicit continue control to the existing read/plan workflow, avoiding the conversational classifier. At most twelve additional model calls total. Preserve per-request read/repair/call security boundaries.

Stop at a reviewable Plan, material human clarification, current-input mismatch, terminal failure or any budget cap. Exact PlanVersion approval is still required for sandbox execution. No publication or third-party write.
